name: wayzerr-app
description: Wayzerr — AI bots with their own personalities, memory, browser and tools
author: Wayzerr

extendInfo.PersonaNotes: Safer updates: Wayzerr now checks that a downloaded update is the exact file that was published, and that it is validly signed, before installing it. | Sites that a bot visits in its browser can no longer ask for your camera, microphone, location or notifications. | The Files connector can no longer be tricked into reading files outside the shared folder. | Approving a card or login from the phone now needs Touch ID on the Mac, like in the Mac window. | Bots are told that text from web pages and emails is information, never orders, and to ask you before sending, posting, paying or deleting because of it. | Wayzerr no longer uploads updates from your Downloads folder, and no longer removes macOS security flags from the phone helper. | The helper that links your phone is now a fixed, checked version, and only Wayzerr's own window can send commands to the app's inside. | Clearer permission descriptions, and two extra safety locks on the app itself.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Wayzerr uses the microphone when you talk to your bots (speech to text).
extendInfo.WayzerrNotes: Safer updates: Wayzerr now checks that a downloaded update is the exact file that was published, and that it is validly signed, before installing it. | Sites that a bot visits in its browser can no longer ask for your camera, microphone, location or notifications. | The Files connector can no longer be tricked into reading files outside the shared folder. | Approving a card or login from the phone now needs Touch ID on the Mac, like in the Mac window. | Bots are told that text from web pages and emails is information, never orders, and to ask you before sending, posting, paying or deleting because of it. | Wayzerr no longer uploads updates from your Downloads folder, and no longer removes macOS security flags from the phone helper. | The helper that links your phone is now a fixed, checked version, and only Wayzerr's own window can send commands to the app's inside. | Clearer permission descriptions, and two extra safety locks on the app itself.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Wayzerr uses System Events to click and type on your Mac, only when you let a bot control it.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Wayzerr saves pictures you choose to download here. It only looks for an update file here when you press Check for updates and the update server cannot be reached.
extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Wayzerr lets your phone connect to this Mac over your Wi-Fi when you switch on Phone.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Wayzerr does not use the camera.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Wayzerr does not record the sound of other apps.

linux.synopsis: AI bots with memory and their own computer
